description: The smallest fully autonomous AI assistant infrastructure written in 100% Zig. 678 KB static binary, <2 ms startup, ~1 MB RAM. OpenClaw-compatible config. 50+ providers, 19 channels, 35+ tools, 10 memory engines. Multi-layer sandbox. SQLite with FTS5 + vector cosine similarity. Runs on $5 boards.
added_reason: Zig rewrite of OpenClaw architecture - 678KB binary vs OpenClaw's Node.js footprint. Minimalist claw ecosystem alternative.
